title: gonolobus angustifolius
intro: Gonolobus angustifolius, commonly known as Mexican Swallowtail Millkwort, is a plant species that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties. The bioactive constituents present in Gonolobus angustifolius include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and exhibiting antioxidant activity. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antispasmodic, anti-ulcer, and hepatoprotective effects, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
